final: WITH lab_patient AS (SELECT l.*, p.SEX FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(CAST(CPK AS FLOAT) / CAST(GPT AS FLOAT)) as sex_avg FROM lab_patient GROUP BY SEX), first_overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg) as first_avg FROM sex_averages), paired_first AS (SELECT sa.SEX, sa.sex_avg, foa.first_avg FROM sex_averages sa CROSS JOIN first_overall_avg foa WHERE sa.sex_avg IS NOT NULL AND foa.first_avg IS NOT NULL), filtered_first AS (SELECT SEX, sex_avg, first_avg, sex_avg - first_avg as diff_from_first FROM paired_first WHERE sex_avg > first_avg), second_overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg) as second_avg FROM filtered_first), paired_second AS (SELECT ff.SEX, ff.sex_avg, ff.first_avg, ff.diff_from_first, soa.second_avg FROM filtered_first ff CROSS JOIN second_overall_avg soa WHERE ff.sex_avg IS NOT NULL AND soa.second_avg IS NOT NULL), filtered_second AS (SELECT SEX, sex_avg, first_avg, diff_from_first, second_avg, sex_avg - second_avg as diff_from_second FROM paired_second WHERE sex_avg > second_avg) SELECT AVG(sex_avg) as avg_sex_average, AVG(diff_from_first) as avg_diff_from_first, AVG(diff_from_second) as avg_diff_from_second FROM filtered_second
